about: Linear: the application scan is dependency-only SDK adoption; the owner also demands the workplace issue browser. This table decides the customer life, published examples and read-back scopes. Workspace controls are mapped to their existing stored-read/mutation decisions, not invented screen operation IDs. Workspace control declarations by /root/journey_evidence_finish, 2026-10-09, are authored source, not a passing walk measurement; other GraphQL fields answer the declared gap.
